variants.asks: light has no beat, so it reads both the slow clock and the long ruler. By how much does a body bend it, in the mass the pull fixes - and does it agree with what was measured?
variants.leads: TWICE NEWTON'S - a stone at c-bar reads the clock alone and turns by r_s/b; light reads the clock and the ruler, once each, and turns by 2r_s/b. That is general relativity's, and what was measured in 1919 and since.

parts.is: what bodies' rays grow where they meet
parts.because: READ OFF THE CONTINUOUS MODEL - not one term of it but all of them, since this is about how the line is made. ANNIHILATION read on two bodies' rays: each still leaves the point behind it where the way behind is dark, and behind a body's ray - lit by a source, not by CREATE, and met in the vacuum's dark half - nothing stands, so both gates are open

standing_for.name: r_{s}
standing_for.because: the record a body adds falls off as `r^{-\paren{D - 2}}` and the metric is the SQUARE of one less it, so its linear term is TWICE the record and at three dimensions `A = 1 - 2\bar{m}/r`. Read against `A = 1 - r_{s}/r` that says `r_{s} = 2\bar{m}` - and the force law fixes `GM = \bar{m}`, so this is `r_{s} = 2GM`, THE SCHWARZSCHILD RADIUS ITSELF and not half of it. Nothing is fitted: the two are read off each other and the two comes from the square

standing_for.name: l.\bar{m}
standing_for.because: READ OFF THE CONTINUOUS MODEL - not one term of it but all of them, since this is about how the line is made. the line is written at a local, l, and what a source puts in there is its mass - a choice over that local's ways out: which of its l.DEG exits it lights, at \bar{m}_{x} apiece, on the ticks its own rule leaves it. The gate the rule asked of the source is inside the choice because it is a statement about which exits, and the line carries nothing of the source but this

standing_for.name: \omega
standing_for.because: READ OFF THE CONTINUOUS MODEL - not one term of it but all of them, since this is about how the line is made. `outward` finds the point across the way, and where that point has been folded it follows it through to the hub it was folded into - so a way that led somewhere still does, hub or point. It comes back with nothing only where there is no point across the way at all, which is the edge of a finite world. The vacuum the line is written in is infinite: every way has a point across it, and the share of ways with room ahead is all of them

standing_for.name: \sigma
standing_for.because: READ OFF THE CONTINUOUS MODEL - not one term of it but all of them, since this is about how the line is made. a rewrite fires on every match it has, once a tick - that is what a rule of this model is. So its rate is ONE per match per tick, and the name on it says which rewrite rather than how often: there is nothing here to choose or to fit

standing_for.name: F
standing_for.because: the facing factor is (1 - d^·j^)/2 and j^ is what the opposing population is doing on average. Alike in every direction, that is nothing - so a meeting in an undisturbed vacuum carries exactly a half, and the two limits it interpolates are one head-on and nought co-moving

standing_for.name: \rho
standing_for.because: and the density the line's own terms carry IS that settled one, everywhere the line is about the vacuum rather than about a source - so a law written in terms of the density can be written in terms of the rates instead

standing_for.name: l.reach\paren{\bar{R}}
standing_for.because: a ray on a heading is taken at one over the free path per step, so the share of what set out that is still on that heading R steps later is one less that, to the R. It is a count of the rays themselves and nothing else: a meeting that takes a ray writes a fold, and the fold is carried by the record and read back out by creation - so this is the NEAR field, the direct arrival, and it is what a body's own cells shadow one another by. Beyond a free path the body is still there, as record

steps.because: the rules, read as a line: every rule of the theory is a term, the reading having run each rule's program on a symbolic match and counted what it does to the population - what it makes, what it takes, what it carries, what a body puts in - so the line is what the rules come to as a crowd rather than a description of them. Everything a theorem of this theory stands on is a term of this line or a reading of one, so every premise below is read off it, and every derivation passes through it

derivation.because: ANNIHILATION contributes it: its body comes to -2 rays and -1 points of space, its quantifier makes it of degree 2 in the density across an edge, which is the facing factor, and its gates let through what they let through

rule /1 "Annihilation" | σ (x: 1 Edge{active}) => x.ANNIHILATE - -2 rays, -1 points of space. The reading follows the body down through the methods it calls, and the ledgers it moves are counted off the assignments it makes

the rule is quantified over 2 population-bearing refs, so its term carries the density to the power 2 - and the two are across an edge, so the rate goes against the oncoming current, which is the facing factor F
the rule fires only where active, so whatever it does it does on that share of its matches and the term carries it

degree: no power of the density

no rewrite of the model puts it there - it is what is put into the box from outside, and the only place anything about a particular problem can be written

the rules do not consult one another - each fires on its own matches once a tick - so what they do to the population adds, and the line is what they come to rather than a description of them. A theory with a rule taken out writes one term fewer here without anything else changing

working: a stone at c-bar reads A alone: r_{s}/b, half of it
steps.because: light has no beat: it goes at A over B's root, so where the clock is slow and the ruler long it is slowed twice, once by each - the index is \sqrt{B/A} = 1 + 2\Phi to first order, where a stone falling past reads only the A. Crossed at closest approach b, at three dimensions, the turn is the index's slope across the path summed along it: twice Newton's. And it is what was measured

derivation.via: a clock held where a body falls
derivation.because: a clock held at r is passed by a body falling in from far at \beta^{2} = 2\Phi, and nothing tells the two apart but that speed: the falling one is what every body does there, the held one is moving against it. So the held clock beats at the falling body's beat, and the time part of the metric is that beat squared - 1 - \beta^{2} = 1 - 2\Phi. In the mass the pull fixes this is 1 - r_{s}/r, with r_{s} twice G m over D - 2: Schwarzschild's, the two not put in but the square of a beat

derivation.via: a body moves or it emits
working: MOVEMENT: every ray a cell a tick, so a body's step is c-bar whatever it does
a source moves or it emits: what it spends going, it does not spend shining
derivation.because: MOVEMENT steps every ray a cell every tick and never holds one back, and a body is rays turning - so a body's step is always the whole of c-bar, and what it spends going somewhere it does not spend standing where it is. What it sends it sends standing: a source moves or it emits, and on a tick it moves it does not shine the way it went. So its going and its standing share one step, at right angles - the going along its heading, the standing across it, where its rays turn - and the standing is its beat: \beta^{2} + \paren{d\tau/dt}^{2} = 1. Fore and aft it comes to the same: what it sends ahead is thinned by 1 - \beta and what it leaves behind by 1 + \beta, and the beat is the mean of the two, \sqrt{\paren{1 - \beta}\paren{1 + \beta}}

derivation.via: the mass is what the vacuum leaves over
derivation.because: the rays' line is linear in what a source puts in, so it solves for it: the share of l's ways a source lights is how the lit share at l moved, less what the vacuum's own rules did to it - put in by creation, taken by the meetings. Where the rays do only what the vacuum does, it is nought; anything else is a source

derivation.via: a body falling in from far
derivation.because: a body let go at rest far off gains speed as the pull does work on it: \frac{d}{dt}\frac{\beta^{2}}{2} = g·\beta, and the pull is the potential's slope - so at R its speed squared is twice the potential there. Every body falls so, whatever it is made of: the pull is the record's slope, and the record does not ask what crosses it

the pull integrated in from far off, where it is nought: one power of the distance weaker than the pull. It is the record the body left, in rays' worth and halved - so the potential is not a second field beside the record, it IS the record

derivation.via: the pull far from a body
working: n_{f,l} - n_{f}\paren{\rho_{\infty}} \to \frac{x.\bar{m}·D·\sigma·F·\rho_{\infty}·x.\bar{R}^{2 - D}}{2·\paren{D - 2}}, past the free path
derivation.because: what a body feels is the record's slope in rays' worth, g = \frac{1}{2}\nabla S_{l}, and S_{l} = 2n_{f,l}. Far from a body - past its free path, where the reach has died - the record it leaves is what the walk carries, one power of the distance weaker than the shell, so its slope falls as the shell does: the inverse square at three dimensions, at a strength that is the lattice's own and nothing chosen. G is the dimension over twice the free path

derivation.via: the record every body leaves at a local
working: the settled vacuum underneath: n_{f} at \rho_{\infty}, \frac{DEG_{0}·\rho_{\infty}^{2}}{4·\paren{1 - \rho_{\infty}}}
x = x_{@t}: every body at its own time, bound once in the sum; x.\bar{R} = l.distance\paren{x.l}, from the local now to the body then
the walk: CREATION lights all DEG of a point's ways, so a heading is drawn afresh; \lambda = \frac{1}{\sigma·F·\rho_{\infty}}, outward at \bar{c}·\paren{D - 2}\lambda / \paren{D·x.\bar{R}}
derivation.because: a meeting turns 2 of l's rays into a fold and a creation reads it back out, so l's rays, DEG of them a way, and 2 times its record move together: the meetings cancel out of their sum, and what is left is what the bodies put in and creation's share against the record l holds over its own ways - nought where the ways have settled, at \rho_{\infty}. So what a body puts in is never lost to the vacuum, only spread: what crosses the shell at a distance in a tick is what the body put out then, and the rays alone are the near field, what still arrives as rays, spread over the same shell - the record is the one less the other, so it is what the meetings took on the way, never less than nought. And what they took walks rather than streams - a creation reads it back out on every way at once - so it crosses each shell at c-bar (D - 2) lambda / (D R), lambda the free path, and beyond the free path stands 1/R^{D-2} deep: in three dimensions it falls as one over the distance, and its slope, the pull, as one over its square, over 2, on the settled record. Each body is read as it was when its rays left it, at its own distance then

derivation.via: a ruler held where a body falls
derivation.because: and the ruler: laid along the fall it is moving against the falling body at the same speed, so a step it spans holds one over the beat as much as it would far off - a body's rays cover a cell a tick, and the held ruler's cells pass at the beat. So the space part is one over the time part, A·B = 1, as Schwarzschild has it
